description: Ask Arctic White for a quote (any items, including those priced on request, large orders, POs or net terms). We email the buyer a link to confirm the request; once confirmed, our team replies with pricing.

address.description: Shipping address. state is required only in the US and Canada (2-letter code); elsewhere it is optional. zip is required except in countries without postal codes.

company.description: Company or institution (optional here; give it as the top-level company)

country.description: 2-letter country code, e.g. US, DE, GB

state.description: 2-letter state or province code in the US and Canada (e.g. PA, ON); region name or blank elsewhere

email.description: Buyer's work email; they confirm the request from it

items.description: Products and quantities. Quantity is in the product's selling unit (usually cases).

note.description: Anything the team should know: timeline, PO, terms, freight account (optional)

name: request_quote

email.description: Where the confirmation link was sent

status.description: The request waits for the buyer to confirm it from the email

title: Request a quote
